cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
project(widgetuse LANGUAGES C)
include(GNUInstallDirs)
add_library(widgetuse STATIC use.c)
set(_widget_hints "")
foreach(_prefix IN LISTS CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH)
	list(APPEND _widget_hints "${_prefix}/lib" "${_prefix}/lib64")
endforeach()
if(DEFINED ENV{LIBRARY_PATH} AND NOT "$ENV{LIBRARY_PATH}" STREQUAL "")
	string(REPLACE ":" ";" _widget_from_env "$ENV{LIBRARY_PATH}")
	list(APPEND _widget_hints ${_widget_from_env})
endif()
if(WIN32 AND DEFINED ENV{LIB} AND NOT "$ENV{LIB}" STREQUAL "")
	list(APPEND _widget_hints $ENV{LIB})
endif()
find_library(widget_lib widget REQUIRED HINTS ${_widget_hints})
target_link_libraries(widgetuse PUBLIC "${widget_lib}")
install(TARGETS widgetuse ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR})
